user_story: As a guest, I want to cancel my booking so that I can free up the reservation.

positive.title: Successful cancellation of a booking
positive.expected_result: Booking is successfully canceled and confirmation message is displayed.

positive.title: Cancellation of a booking within the allowed time frame
steps: Select a booking due 3 days from now
positive.expected_result: Booking is successfully canceled and confirmation message is displayed.

positive.title: Cancellation of a booking with multiple reservations
steps: Select a booking with multiple rooms
positive.expected_result: All selected rooms are successfully canceled and confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel a booking that has already passed
steps: Select a booking that has already completed
negative.expected_result: Cancellation option is not available and an error message indicating that the booking cannot be canceled is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to cancel a non-existent booking
steps: Attempt to select a booking not in the list
negative.expected_result: Cancellation option is not available and an error message indicating that the booking does not exist is displayed.

edge.title: Cancellation of a booking made just before the cut-off time
steps: Select a booking that is about to start in 1 hour
edge.expected_result: Booking is successfully canceled despite being close to the cut-off time and confirmation message is displayed.

edge.title: Cancellation attempt during high traffic times
steps: Login as a guest during peak booking hours
edge.expected_result: Booking is canceled successfully, but response time may be longer due to server load.
